items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: There was also a master of ceremonies by the name of Willy Sanders who was also French and he entertained the audience by telling jokes, some that I eventually understood.

ctx.x: We went on visits to the Sea of Ice and were happy in our little chalet which was the first time we felt that we had our own blue heaven. All that was missing was Baby, and we found a little cat to take the place of one.

There was only one other place in town that had a group of musicians and that was the Casino. But they were not a jazz group and played the type of music that most groups and larger orchestras were obliged to play in small town casinos. When the public wanted to hear jazz, they came to l'Outa and we had a good crowd every night. There was also a master of ceremonies by the name of Willy Sanders who was also French and he entertained the audience by telling jokes, some that I eventually understood. Harry, the…

We finished at l'Outa the 24th of August, a little early to finish a summer season that's the way it was there. I had some gigs in the vicinity of a town called Sete in the Southern part of France, but the first one was not until the 29th of August. I was also contacted for a tour of 21 days in Germany starting the 12th of September.
